text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Arrived!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Reach meetup spot, check weather.
Just like morning, clear sunny skies! Mmm～,
feels great♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Listened to radio calisthenics,
feeling loose.
Now just greet everyone——

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Then MiRule clear!
Refreshed, hype rising～♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
——Ah, everyone, over here! Good Miling～!
Good hustle on morning training.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hii, Gran-chan!
Today too, Love Me♡, Love You♡,
Good Miling☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Good……Miling.
Glad skies cleared. Lovely morning.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
G-good morn-……G-good Miling, Gran-chan.
Sorry, did we……keep you waiting?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Nope, not at all! Ehehe,
suck at waiting around,
so super glad everyone made it on time～!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Alright,
ready to roll? Been ages since we hung out,
let's play all day～♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Looked forward to this forever,
hype at 120 Miles☆

text_block_list.name: Athletics Staff
text_block_list.text:
Batting cages open today!
Special stage hosts pro gymnast showcase!
Plus main attraction——

text_block_list.name: Athletics Staff
text_block_list.text:
Max difficulty! As seen on TV,
Challenge Athletique!
Ninja obstacle run with zero clears
recorded!

text_block_list.name: Athletics Staff
text_block_list.text: Open to all challengers～!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Whoa,
looks brutal……Layout makes next step tough
to read, huh?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-indeed……even knowing route beforehand,
demands serious athletic skill.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Starting section especially looks intricate
and tricky,
requires strict footing focus……

text_block_list.name: Athletics Staff
text_block_list.text:
Precisely! Droves failed right at start,
maybe overtuned——

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Miler-!

text_block_list.name: Athletics Staff
text_block_list.text: Whaaaaaaaaat?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Any course, these Miler legs crush easily!

text_block_list.name: All 3
text_block_list.text: Flawless run?!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Didn't even slip or stumble once……!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
How far home run? Basically super far,
right?
Alllright, keeping eyes locked on ball～!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Swing-! Dead center, home run!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Done effortlessly……! Spectacular!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Even making contact tough……watching Gran-chan
tricks brain into thinking anyone could……

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, hype building up, huh～?
Hey, seen that gymnast on TV before!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Whoa,
awesome!
Flipped and stuck landing on same spot!
……maybe like this?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Huuuuh……?!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Knew she was gifted,
but seeing first-hand defies belief.
Absurd athletic instincts, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Zero hesitation tackling unfamiliar
moves……Unshakable self-trust?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Proof once more……you possess true genius,
Gran-san.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
C-could it be your body just moves on
reflex……? 
All those movements looking so well-drilled
are pure instinct……?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
How wonderful~ It's all intuition, right? 
Must be a gift you were born with~♡

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, thanks for the praise☆

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ——Though honestly, I *am* Gran Alegria!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
The greatest Miler! 
There's nothing I can't do!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Oh right, how did that scout turn out? 
Didn't some super-elite Trainer want you?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Oh, that? Turned 'em down already!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Huh…… E-eeeh? Um…… was something wrong? 
Did your racing philosophies clash……?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Nope! But look, to be my Trainer, 
they've gotta meet my standards!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Those are my MiRules! Elite or rookie,
doesn't matter. 
If you don't pass the MiRules test,
you're out!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Gran-san's MiRules…… If you tell me the
conditions, 
maybe I could help look for someone too……

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
All good! They're gonna be *my* Trainer, 
so gotta scout 'em myself——……?

——On a break from work,
recharging at a cafe. 
After sitting down,
I placed a few training 
manuals I brought along onto the table.
choice_data_list: So that I can make any dream come ...

text_block_list.text:
Muttered softly that I wanted to do my best.
Panicked 
when it slipped out loud and quickly covered
my mouth.

Wiping my hands with the warm towel,
I recalled 
the decorative horseshoe in the window
display 
and absentmindedly folded the cloth into
that shape.

Opened the menu,
scanning back and forth with a finger. 
Tapped a few choices, still undecided.
choice_data_list: I guess a salad to start……

text_block_list.text:
Just as I finally settled on what to
order, 
I looked up——

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
……A towel shaped like a horseshoe. 
Fingers pacing out distances like measuring
miles……

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
And that double-tap like a starting
signal!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Plus ordering a salad!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
……Found you at last! 
Please become my Trainer!
